crossRefs.note: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

people.name: Ham
people.line: One of Noah's three sons, father of Canaan.

translations.web: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.
translations.bsb: These are the sons of Ham according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
translations.kjv: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
translations.asv: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, in their nations.
